description:
Measured on s517b (emission-ab vs ef48da1b, 657 files, eab4): #2636 treats a QUALIFIED callee with no same-file record as unseen and wraps a raw-slot scalar argument in p-copy-back (--pcl-cb--N temporaries + %p-copy-in / %p-copy-back-value), but the core namespaces never write through @_: builtin::pl-reftype in lib/Scalar/Util.pm (2 sites), lib/Sub/Util.pm (1) and lib/attributes.pm (2); the shim primitives builtin::pl-zlib_crc32 / zlib_adler32 in lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm (and Scalar::Util::dualvar there); utf8::pl-native_to_unicode / unicode_to_native in perl-tests/translate.t (2); B::svref_2object in perl-tests/scalar.t is the same kind.  Fix shape: exempt callees in the runtime-owned core namespaces (builtin::, utf8::, and any name the runtime defines as a builtin) at the _copy_back_args decision in Pl/ExprToCL.pm -- one predicate; the bar is the wraps disappearing from those files in emission-ab with RCDIFF 0 and the cb1/zlib guards unchanged.  No code yet (Fable s518).

=== DONE (s519a m4, 5a83730f on the s520 rebase; landed 2026-10-18) ===
Pl/ExprToCL.pm's copy-back decision exempts a callee in perl's runtime-owned core namespaces -- builtin::, utf8::, Internals::, CORE:: -- unless it is one of the builtins that WRITE their argument (arg_writing_builtin), one predicate at _copy_back_args.  Wraps gone from lib/Scalar/Util.pm (2), lib/Sub/Util.pm (1), lib/attributes.pm (2), lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm (2 of 4: the builtin::pl-zlib_* pair), perl-tests/translate.t (2).  Scalar::Util::dualvar (lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm) and B::svref_2object (perl-tests/scalar.t) KEEP theirs: they are MODULE namespaces a program can redefine (rule 9a), not the runtime's.  Guard Pl/t/copy-back-01.t 4 rows (1-2 fail on fca3593b); the cb1 / zlib guards unchanged.  emission-ab vs fca3593b: the wraps leaving are the expected DIFFs (see the s519a session-log section for the counts).
subject: copy-back (#2636) wraps calls to core-namespace callees (builtin:: / utf8::) that never write their arguments -- exempt them
